scenarios.name: Inspect the keyboard customization initial state

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon tab is selected
the user opens Customize from the Options panel
the keyword search field is empty
the command list has Keys, Command Name, Type and Category columns
"Use default multi-character command aliases" is unchecked
the Reset All Keys and Copy to Clipboard controls are visible
cancels and Apply are unavailable because no edits are staged
the customization dialog closes without changing the active sketch
